mainPoints.point: Siri will be completely revamped as an 'AI companion', featuring a Dynamic Island entry point and a standalone app.

oneSentenceSummary: On the eve of WWDC26, this article compiles leaked information to provide a comprehensive preview of Apple's AI strategy 'make-up exam' results: Siri's transformation into an AI companion, a proprietary search engine, AI photo editing, and an open platform, while also exploring the final legacy test of Cook's tenure.
originalTitle: 库克送 Siri 最后一程
summary: Published just before Apple's WWDC26, this article, based on leaks from Mark Gurman and others, systematically outlines a comprehensive upgrade to Apple's AI strategy. Core elements include: Siri evolving from a voice command tool into an 'AI companion' with a new Dynamic Island entry point, a standalone app, multi-command processing capabilities, and a foundation built on the Gemini model; Apple's first proprietary web search product, rivaling Perplexity; deep AI integration into the Camera and Photos apps, including Visual Intelligence, AI expansion, and recomposition; and the introduction of the CoreAI system, opening AI capabilities to third parties, potentially creating a new 'agent commission' model. The article concludes by focusing on Cook's tenure, labeling Apple Intelligence a 'major stain' and his last chance before handing over the reins, while analyzing real-world challenges like privacy, hardware costs, and the developer ecosystem.
title: Cook Sends Siri Off on Its Final Journey
